notes: Same series as animation2 (credits mention Kang Tao, i.e. the Cyberpunk setting; red-marked boy, blond boy, masked pink-haired girl, eyepatch old cyborg all recur), so animation2 labels reused. NEW characters: green_haired_cap_girl = girl with long green hair in a blue/white peaked cap with a pink cheek mark (card 4; also C12T7, U55, U56, U64); visor_man = dark-skinned man with a striped grey visor over his eyes, orange collar (card 14 majority, C14T1); bandaged_glasses_man = grey-haired man with glasses and a plaster on his forehead (C14T0, U2, ~2:07-2:13); brown_haired_man = scared brown-haired man with tear-streaked grey face beside him (U1, U3). Uncertain: teal_haired_cyborg used for the small green-jacket character with a teal face plate, round goggles and red eyes (cards 6, 8, C7T0/T1/T7, U22, U39, U43) - best match to the animation2 description but could be a new character; old_cyborg used for the eyepatch man with stitched blond/white hair and goatee (cards 5, 7) - his eyepatch has a round red lens; blond_man for card 3 (olive-blond hair, dark eye make-up/glasses); smoking_man for card 10 (black hair, cracked face plate, gold chin) plus C2T0 and red-lit U7 (U7 less sure). Cards 13 and 15 (all-pink long-banged hair, no mask visible) labelled pink_haired_girl but could be blond_boy in pink light; card 9 (green-eyed close-ups) labelled blond_boy. U31/U32 red-haired smiling girl in warm light taken as pink_haired_girl (U32 shifts to her pink-haired masked look). 24:14-24:27 yellow flashback: U71/U72/U74 taken as a younger old_cyborg; C2T11/C2T12/U68/U70 pale simple faces with dark hair might be white_masked_figure but left unknown. Green-lit armoured soldier faces (U17,U18,U20,U29,U30,U46,U47) left unknown. Checked 989: red_marked_boy lying with face turned, unboxed; 1483: masked pink-haired girl in wheelchair, small, unboxed.
